nodes.label: Mark 5 Color Marker (Pink/Coral)
nodes.description: A small solid pink/coral colored swatch image used as a visual marker/highlight indicator in the E-Tipitaka PC application. Part of a numbered series of color markers (mark1-markN) likely used to color-code bookmarks, highlights, or annotations in Tipitaka text passages.

nodes.label: Color-Coded Bookmark/Highlight System
nodes.rationale: Numbered mark icons (mark1, mark2, ... mark5, ...) provide users with multiple distinct colors to categorize bookmarks or highlights in scripture text. Pink/coral as the 5th marker offers visual differentiation from earlier markers in the sequence.
